output.reason: The evidence shows the charge table includes a “Pre-payment charge” of 2% of principal outstanding, payable “on pre-payment or foreclosure.” It also states in UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(1) that “prepayment charge not permitted,” and that this rule applies to the given case (listed as “Applies to this case”). Therefore, the bank’s table lists the pre-payment charge, but the applicable UCB rule prohibits charging it in this case.
